Personal

Music has always been the quiet pulse beneath my days. In my spare moments, I enjoy playing the piano, flute, and banjo, with my strongest proficiency and longest experience in piano. My piano performance and rehearsal videos are featured on RedNotes. I also have a passion for creative writing.
